name: mainsail
title: Mainsail
author: bespoked
description: Installs Mainsail v2.17.0 as a second web frontend. Runs on port 81 by default so Fluidd stays on port 80. Set port 80 to make Mainsail primary; Fluidd shifts to 81 automatically. Bleeding-edge build: adds the AFC "Toolchanger Eject Mode" toggle (Eject docks the mounted tool on a toolchanger).
tagline: Mainsail web interface alongside Fluidd, on your chosen port.

variables.name: MAINSAIL_PORT
variables.description: Port for Mainsail (default: 81). Set to 80 to make Mainsail primary; Fluidd moves to 81.

config.label: Mainsail port
config.hint: Auto-assigned. Make Mainsail primary to serve it on port 80.

attributions:
# Attributions - mainsail

**Plugin author:** the mainsail-crew, packaged by Bespok3d

Installs the Mainsail web interface.

| Upstream project | Author | Licence | Needed at runtime | Code ships in this package |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Mainsail | the mainsail-crew | GPL-3.0 | yes | yes |

The released Mainsail web bundle is shipped verbatim inside this plugin (currently v2.18.0).
Upstream: https://github.com/mainsail-crew/mainsail

The U1 packaging approach follows the Extended Firmware overlay `63-app-mainsail` (paxx12), GPL-3.0.
